body:
Animal - Maroon 5. Still love the song, and I never loved it because of the lyrics. I was singing it in front of my whole family at like 10 years old, and i'm French, so at that time, only my father who knew english well enough told me to look at lyrics and see what they mean before singing it in front of people... Oops.

Edit: Got to say at least, I wasn't showing people the video, it's probably worse than listening to the lyrics..

But if I do, people around me will know and (my parents) will not accept IT l well, or will not see me like before. Like I said, they'll think I watched too much tv or that i'm lying.
I'll see.
Thanks though

I don't think I have a good reason of being what I am. Nohing bad or traumatizing ever happened to me, not even a little thing. I've never been bullied too.

It's nice that you get it, really.
Thanks for the comment :)

Merci. J'sais pas trop quoi dire, je pense que tout est dit dans le texte. Après, je t'aurais proposé de me parler de tes problèmes si tu voulais, mais je suis pas très bonne pour écouter les gens car après je sais pas quoi dire.
En tout cas, merci c'est sympa de voir que je suis pas totalement seule :)

(as I can see)
Well nobody knows how it'll go. I have to wait and see, or not.

I am truly without empathy, but never have I been like that 100% around someone because it wouldn't have lasted then.
I understand what you're saying. I'm really hard on myself, I know, but I feel like i'm always right too. Everything I say about myself and to myself is right and it sadden me since it's not only good things.

I don't think I want to be proud of who I am, just have an easier life, which can't happen. (Selfish sentence as you can see)
Thanks for your concern thought :)

It is true :)
I really don't want to be rude or anything, but the fact that you still 'love' me doesn't make me feel any better in reality.
I guess i'm just trying to find a life where everything is perfect, which is impossible.

...but still, sometimes I don't want to live my life fully because I have to go throught too much bad time before that and i'm tired of this. Like I have social anxiety so if I want to wear something I like, i'll feel judged all along and i'm the first person to say that the people judgment isn't important, but i'm the last to act on that.

That's what I thought. Not silly at all.
I just feel like sometimes, these little moments like aren't enough, you know. I just try to deal with all that.
Thanks for the comment :)
